metadata.name: Cosmic Health NASA-Informed Health Guidance
metadata.purpose: Local health-monitoring guidance for the Cosmic Health prototype
metadata.disclaimer: This is an educational decision-support resource. It is not an official NASA medical system, does not diagnose medical conditions, and does not replace professional medical care.

general.name: General Health Monitoring
guidance: Use personal baseline data when available.
Monitor trends across multiple observations rather than relying on a single measurement.
Record symptoms consistently, including severity and changes over time.
Consider multiple health indicators together.
Persistent or worsening symptoms should receive appropriate professional evaluation.

sleep.name: Sleep and Recovery
guidance: Maintain a consistent sleep and recovery routine when possible.
Monitor repeated changes in sleep duration or quality.
Track fatigue and alertness alongside sleep data.
Look for trends across several days rather than relying on one night's data.
sleep.when_flagged: A repeated deterioration in sleep or recovery indicators should prompt closer monitoring.
sleep.professional_care: Persistent or severe sleep problems or fatigue should be discussed with an appropriate healthcare professional.

cardiovascular.name: Cardiovascular Health
guidance: Compare measurements with the individual's established baseline when available.
Monitor persistent changes rather than isolated readings.
Record symptoms together with cardiovascular measurements.
Track cardiovascular measurements over time.
cardiovascular.when_flagged: A persistent change from an individual's normal pattern should receive closer monitoring.
cardiovascular.professional_care: New, severe, or rapidly worsening cardiovascular symptoms require appropriate medical evaluation.

musculoskeletal.name: Musculoskeletal Health
guidance: Record the location and severity of discomfort.
Monitor whether symptoms are improving, stable, or worsening.
Track changes in mobility and physical function.
Consider repeated symptoms as a trend.
musculoskeletal.when_flagged: Increasing pain or declining physical function should prompt closer monitoring.
musculoskeletal.professional_care: Persistent, severe, or worsening pain or loss of normal physical function should receive appropriate professional evaluation.

respiratory.name: Respiratory Health
guidance: Record respiratory symptoms and their severity.
Monitor whether symptoms are improving or worsening.
Look for persistent changes across multiple observations.
Consider respiratory symptoms together with other health indicators.
respiratory.when_flagged: Persistent or worsening respiratory symptoms should receive closer attention.
respiratory.professional_care: Severe or rapidly worsening breathing difficulty requires immediate appropriate medical attention.

mentalBehavioral.name: Mental and Behavioral Wellbeing
guidance: Monitor changes in mood and stress over time.
Consider sleep and workload when interpreting changes in wellbeing.
Record persistent changes rather than relying on a single observation.
Maintain appropriate recovery and healthy routines.
mentalBehavioral.when_flagged: Persistent changes in mood, stress, concentration, or behavior should prompt closer monitoring.
mentalBehavioral.professional_care: Significant or persistent changes in wellbeing should be discussed with an appropriate healthcare or mental-health professional.

immuneGeneral.name: General and Immune Health
guidance: Record symptoms consistently.
Monitor changes in severity and duration.
Compare observations with the individual's normal baseline.
Look for persistent or worsening patterns.
immuneGeneral.when_flagged: Persistent or increasing symptoms should prompt closer monitoring.
immuneGeneral.professional_care: Persistent, severe, or worsening symptoms should be evaluated by an appropriate healthcare professional.

otherSymptoms.name: Other Symptoms
guidance: Record what the symptom is and when it occurs.
Record severity and duration.
Monitor whether it is improving, stable, or worsening.
Use repeated observations to identify trends.
otherSymptoms.when_flagged: A symptom that becomes more severe, frequent, or persistent should receive closer monitoring.
otherSymptoms.professional_care: Severe, persistent, or rapidly worsening symptoms should receive appropriate medical evaluation.
